visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black beret, a pink long-sleeved shirt, and black overalls, stands in front of a dense background of blooming white plum blossoms. She holds a small white quadcopter drone with circular propeller guards close to her face, smiling and looking directly at the camera. The lighting is bright and natural daylight. (2) The scene shifts to a top-down view of the woman's hands as she holds the white drone against the backdrop of a grassy ground and blue sneakers. She demonstrates opening the four folded propeller guards. (3) The woman is in a sunny park with green trees and grass. She holds her hand out flat, and the drone lifts off from her palm into the air. She wears a black beret and a pink shirt. (4) The camera follows the woman as she runs through a field with scattered trees and large rocks. The drone is seen flying steadily behind her, tracking her movements. (5) In a different part of the park, the drone is shown flying towards a tree trunk. It makes contact with the bark and falls to the grassy ground, demonstrating the protective nature of its guards. (6) A man in a black jacket is shown kneeling to pick up the drone from the grass, then standing and pointing to the device with a smile. (7) Close-up shot of the woman holding a smartphone, displaying a live video feed from the drone. The interface shows tracking squares and various settings. (8) An aerial montage follows, showing wide-angle views of the white blossom forest from a high altitude, comparing the image quality to other professional drones. (9) The man is shown again in a wooded area, pulling the compact white drone out of his jacket pocket to show its small size. (10) The video concludes with the woman and man together in the park, waving at the drone as it flies away, with the blossom forest in the background.

(10) [Subtitle]: 不需要任何繁瑣操作 獨旅也可以輕鬆開始你的拍攝之旅. (11) [Subtitle]: 而且它還有自動跟隨功能 AI智能跟拍. (12) [Variety]: (跟超緊!!). (13) [Subtitle]: 捕捉每一個精彩瞬間 完全不用擔心畫面會漏掉或是跑掉. (14) [Subtitle]: 這台DJI Flip的安全感 也是一流!!. (15) [Subtitle]: 全包圍槳保設計 讓飛行更有保障. (16) [Subtitle]: 甚至你穿過樹林! 它都可以穩定的追蹤. (17) [Variety]: (實拍畫面). (18) [Subtitle]: 搭配Care保固方案 真的碰撞之後 維修也更加安心. (19) [Variety]: (不擔心👍). (24) [Subtitle]: 那你還在等什麼? DJI Flip 讓你飛空拍變得更簡單 安全又更專業!. (25) [Subtitle]: 所以我才說 它不只是一台空拍機 還是我們的空中攝影師!

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman in a pink top, black beret, and black overalls; a man in a black jacket and dark trousers.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A lush park with green lawns, scattered trees, large grey rocks, and a dense forest of blooming white flowers (likely plum or cherry blossoms).

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice greeting the audience over an upbeat, rhythmic electronic pop track with a strong synth bassline. A rapid 'whoosh' SFX signals the start of the product intro. (2) A clear mechanical 'click' SFX is heard as the drone blades are unfolded, followed by a male voice providing instructional details with a calm but professional tone. (3) A distinct high-pitched 'whirring' sound of drone motors triggers a new phase as flight begins, blending with the ongoing energetic BGM. (4) A sharp 'thud' or percussive impact SFX occurs when the drone hits a tree, followed immediately by a lighthearted, casual comment from the narrator and a comedic 'ding' sound effect. (5) The BGM swells slightly in volume during an instrumental section as digital UI beeps represent screen interface interactions. (6) The video ends with the female voice returning to a high arousal, enthusiastic pitch for the final recommendation, punctuated by a concluding stinger SFX and the music fading out quickly.
